method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

themes.title: Procedure master and capture rework
themes.description: Procedure master, RVG group hierarchy, two-tab picker, modifier records with explanations, ASA as ordinary modifier, locked age/included modifiers, real RVG values, rate x time removed, source wording kept. XL, shared BtmCaptureBlock lands on all three apps.

themes.title: Pricing precedence and adjustment gating
themes.description: Anaesthetist adjustment gated to No contract and first-party Contracts, separate office override, independent fixed rate and discount, no-charge invoice, modifier split above four units. L.

themes.title: Slot, Draft List and List lifecycle
themes.description: Optional anaesthetist on List, DRAFT/ACTIVE rename, Draft List admin page and creation paths, statuses as master data, return-or-assign on mark-unavailable, anaesthetist moves own List, tiers and private pairings. XL, structural first.

themes.description: Staged import rows, per-row admin decision, field-difference approval, unmatched queue; nothing auto-applies. HL7/FHIR/dead-letter tooling is Future and should be demoted. L shared build.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations:
Net: EP-01 core canvas (2 entries per anaesthetist per day, default free, 14d back to 4 months forward, roll-forward on day advance, status colours) is in place. Headline new concepts absent: Draft Lists, priority tiers, preference/pairing warnings, editable status master data, return-or-assign on mark-unavailable. Prototype has no separate Slot: List is slot and List (statusKey + state); catalogue allows that as a storage choice, but the status vs booking context blur shows in admin (a 'free' List with a hospital displays as private).

Structural changes: (1) List.anaesthetistId optional + Draft state; existing ListState DRAFT (assigned, being worked) becomes ACTIVE and DRAFT is reused for unassigned. EP-07 rename touches lifecycle.ts, editRefusal, forward-list filters, submitList, seed, audit labels, tests. Do first. (2) Status table becomes master data (editable label/colour, add) which ripples through theme/statusColours, LIST_STATUS_KEYS union, parity test, StatusChip/legend, availability controls, day grid. (3) New master data: anaesthetist tier (admin only) and surgeon/anaesthetist preference pairings (FT-13.6, US-13.6.3/13.6.4); US-01.3.5 and 01.3.6 depend on them; names open in OQ-102. (4) Bump PERSIST_VERSION. (5) Canvas should skip inactive anaesthetists (Anaesthetist.active never read). (6) Remove the word 'slot' from UI copy and store refusal messages.

Dependencies: US-01.4.3 (anaesthetist moves own List to office or colleague), US-01.4.2 (admin availability finder), US-01.4.7 (single Booking move, OQ-85) and US-01.6.1 (create Draft List) are not in this list but gate US-01.4.5, US-01.5.5, US-01.6.3 and FT-01.6 creation paths. Recurring-booking-onto-unavailable becomes a Draft List at generation (OQ-81 meeting update; only part 3, sickness, still open). Integration reschedule clash (US-02.5.2) should create a Draft List rather than manualIntervention. US-01.4.6 AC3 (prepayments re-checked) conflicts with US-06.3.5 (a move re-triggers no prepayment calc); treat US-06.3.5 as current and flag the AC for catalogue cleanup.

Demo-guide impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md ~l.186-225): S2 Beat 2 (phone-book Sharma Tue 21 PM) and S2 Beat 3 (reassign Rutherford's Wed 22 AM List to Sharma with vacated slot Unavailable) change to return-to-office then assign Draft List with warnings; 'vacated slot' wording must go. Seed day-design fixups and DemoControlPanel.tsx:277 S2 description change with it. Add a Draft Lists beat to the Admin script; the availability beat gains the return-or-assign prompt. The amber conflict wording stays only for Bookings landing on already-unavailable Slots.

Verifier changes: US-01.6.3 Missing to Partial (existing office reassign covers the assign step); US-01.4.6 points corrected (prepayment re-check dropped per US-06.3.5, size S); EP-01 gains the inactive-anaesthetist gap and more 'slot' strings. All other verdicts upheld; no false Matches found since none were graded Matches.

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations: Structural: hospital intake needs a new staged-row model (pending import rows + matching screen) in store/domain; today HL7/FHIR messages and PDF rows apply directly (code comment at integrationActions.ts:161 names this catch-up Phase 33). The matching screen is shared by FT-02.1 / US-02.1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.5 and the unmatched queue (US-02.1.4, outside this list): build once (L) and treat the rest as increments, so do not sum the sizes. Nearest analogue to reuse: Integration Monitor (message log, feed field mapping, Surgeon PDFs tab); its HL7/FHIR/dead-letter machinery is Future scope in the catalogue's view, and FEED-CPH (Christchurch Public) is out of scope for first release. US-02.5.7 (Procedure source texts) is a cross-cutting data-model change (Procedure.sourceTexts[{text,system,arrivedAt}], PERSIST_VERSION bump, seed, createBooking no-trim, ingest adds rather than overwrites, 'as given' field on admin phone-advice and anaesthetist manual forms) and feeds US-02.3.1, US-02.4.1 and US-02.1.2; display above procedure/Contract is US-03.1.9. US-02.3.3 needs hospital and surgeon's-room contact emails (US-13.4.1, US-13.6.1), links to change history US-02.5.5, and the move-own-List office notification (US-01.4.3 / US-13.8.2, not present). Dependencies: US-01.6.1 Draft List, US-02.1.4 unmatched queue, OQ-13 (format unknown, keep simulated fields generic). Demo guide impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S1 Beat 1 (MSG-STG-1001 creates a Booking directly) and Beat 4 (MSG-CPH-2001 dead-letter, mapping fix, MSG-STG-1002) change when hospital rows go to a matching screen; S2 phone-advice beat is touched by the 'as given' field. Demo triggers: 'Receive hospital download' / 'Sync from hospitals' on the matching screen. Verification: all 9 gradings upheld; only tweaks were confidence (US-02.1.1, 02.1.5, 02.5.7 medium) and the Copy-booking nuance on US-02.3.1.

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations: EP-03 holds up as one structural gap: the prototype is still the July model (Procedure = free-text description + one RVG base code; Contract is a stored id set only by the office). Missing structure: source text vs procedure wording, procedure master and two-tab picker, anaesthetist-editable Contract with a filtered list, modifier records with explanations and locked age/included modifiers, Contract-driven price rule (first-party vs third-party vs fixed discount), dated billing lines without rate x time, ASA as an ordinary modifier. Do this as one capture rework (shared BtmCaptureBlock serves mobile, web and admin, so one change lands on all three). Cross-epic dependencies: EP-05 (procedure master, RVG groups, modifier table, US-05.1.x), EP-04 (Contract kinds and list filter, US-04.2.x/US-04.3.2), EP-13 (out-of-range warning routine, US-13.7.1; only prepaymentUnpaid exists), EP-07 (review flag for anaesthetist changes, US-07.2.2), EP-06/08 (prepaid amount), EP-02 (as-received text, US-02.5.7). Verifier corrections: (1) base units are not actually blocked out of range in the UI: the UnitsCard B stepper accepts any value silently while only the range selector clamps and the validator rejects missing/out-of-range baseUnitsSelected, so the real gap is no warning plus a contradictory validator rule; (2) BMI, emergency and awake intubation modifiers exist (OB, ASE, AI1), only ASA is wrongly separated; (3) prePaidByProcedure lives only in domain invoice build, not selectors. Open questions (OQ-99, 101, 95, 96, 89, 103) all land inside the rework. Demo-guide impact: S1 Beat 3, S4 prepayment beat, S5 compliance edits (AS1/AS2 on Chen) and the demo-plausible modifier discussion. Existing triggers (fire-hospital-message, S4 jump, demo clock) cover the automatic parts; no new EP-03 triggers are essential, but seed needs older billed Lists (PERSIST_VERSION bump) for US-03.1.6 and patients in the age bands for US-03.3.8.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations: EP-04 is a structural rewrite of the billing model, not an extension. Catalogue: one Contract per Procedure, holder decides who is billed (pays AA, else Booking payer), a single holderless 'No contract (RVG)', no hospital/insurer/procedure defaults. Prototype: Procedure.billingRoute (hospital/billableParty/insurer) + optional governingContractId, Type 1/2/3 contracts, protected default Type 1 per hospital/insurer, fallback in invoiceBuild.resolveContractForProcedure / contracts.selectContract, counterparty by route. Verification changes: FT-04.2 upgraded Partial to Contradicts ('Any code' Type 3 row prices a whole contract; contract-wide Type 2 rate); added price>0 refusal as wrong for US-04.2.4 and dropped a weak BTM-fallback point from US-04.2.2; US-04.1.1, 04.2.1, 04.2.2, 04.2.4, 04.2.10, 04.3.3 and EP-04 Contradicts all upheld; the Missing items (US-04.1.4 AA code, US-04.2.11 combinations) re-grepped with no hits. No Matches in this epic. Missing entities: Contract Holder (pays-AA flag, billable party, first-party anaesthetist), per-procedure contract lines (rate/discount/units/holder code), dated linked versions + review date, aaCode and composite search, invoice layout/delivery/GST fields on Contract, contract-named booking references, snapshot at AUTHORISED, insurance indication (OQ-93), procedure master and two-tab picker (EP-05 dependency, so XL sizes are lower bounds; bundle with EP-05). Cross-epic dependencies: EP-05 (procedure master, RVG groups, general procedure, anaesthetist adjustment only on first-party/No contract), EP-03 (picker on booking, mark-complete gate), EP-11 (Booking payer, direct insurer), EP-06 (prepaid from first-party contract), EP-07/08 (review warnings, invoice reproduction, additional invoices). Demo impacts: S5 Beat 4 (edit Health NZ end date) becomes new-version + snapshot view; the 'billing-failure' trigger (registry.ts:197, end-dates COS ACC contract then Resolve & retry clears the end date) relies on contractIneffective/no-default semantics and needs a new failure scenario (e.g. Booking with no Contract); demo-guide cheat sheet 'Contracts' (Type 1/2/3, protected default) and route chips ('Hospital / contract holder') must be rewritten; all 12 seeded contracts and procedures' billingRoute/governingContractId remodelled; PERSIST_VERSION bump. Existing demo controls usable: clock advance (new version taking effect), fire-hospital-message (feed Booking arriving without a Contract), S5 scenario jump. Open questions OQ-89, 93, 98, 99, 103 should be decided or built provisionally.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: Prototype still implements the original July RFP pricing model for EP-05. Verification found the reviewer's grades largely sound; one regrade (US-05.2.5 Partial to Contradicts: additional-procedure and no-match fallbacks to BTM, and non-RVG lines added on top of a fixed price) and small evidence corrections (FT-05.2 validator point, US-05.4.3 visibility). Gaps cluster in three structural changes. (1) Missing procedure master and RVG hierarchy: no PROCEDURE entity, body section, subgroup, system code or general procedure per group; RVG and modifier masters are read-only demo data with invented codes (not NZSA H/S codes); hip and shoulder codes wrongly absorb P1 while real Neuro/Spine codes are absent. Needs new domain types, seed (illustrative ~400-row list), audited admin CRUD, picker rework (FT-04.3), and base-unit precedence contract line > procedure > group (touches US-04.2.x). (2) Pricing precedence rewrite: single priceOverride slot must split into anaesthetist-typed price vs office override, gated to No contract and first-party Contracts; Type 2 either/or basis must become independent fixed rate and fixed discount (US-04.2.2) shown locked to the anaesthetist; $0 / 100% must yield a no-charge invoice (invoiceBuild skips $0 groups, UI blocks fixed fee 0); Type 3 must always price from its own Contract line, including additional procedures. (3) Multi-procedure rule: replace 'additional = time only' with modifier split (<=4 on primary, else equal split, remainder to primary); needs a Booking-level pass in feeContext; OQ-90 may retire it. Modifier master also needs ASA pre-fill removed (fee.ts:79-85, AsaCard), age modifiers auto-applied from DOB (OQ-95), and non-numeric unit values. Items that already match: unit value per anaesthetist (US-05.2.1), Type 2 fixed rate (US-05.2.6), GST exclusive (US-05.2.7), per-procedure attribution (US-05.3.5), office override (US-05.4.2), and the tiered time maths (US-05.2.2, apart from hard-coded tiers and the stale 'assumption' caption). Dependencies: EP-03 (US-03.3.4/3.3.6/3.3.8 capture; the legacy Method 3 rate x time billing line is graded there), EP-04 (Contracts, picker, Contract lines), EP-06 (prepaid by RVG group), EP-08 (no-charge invoice, ad hoc/credit note). Demo-guide impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S3 Beat 1 pins invoice figures (AA-2026-0002 Forte $396.18; Prentice $152.38/$91.43) which change with base/modifier/seed-code/modifier-value changes; S3 Beat 4 uses the Type 2 contract; S1/S2 capture beats use the current picker and ASA pre-fill. Bump PERSIST_VERSION on any seed/shape change. Several catalogue screenshots for these stories (hip replacement P1 struck through, rate x time line, anatomical-site picker) show the current prototype, not the new rules, so they are not evidence of conformance.

epics.title: Prepayment
epics.observations: Prototype implements the July RFP model: selfFundedPrepayment payment category per procedure (retired per domain-model row 23), full-estimate or split-deposit, manual office raise, balance netted at billing run. The catalogue replaced all of it: profile prepaid set (FT-06.1; also US-12.1.3, US-05.1.3), first-party fixed-price Contracts per anaesthetist (US-04.2.14, US-04.3.4, OQ-91; no anaesthetist-held Contract exists), auto-generation at setup with admin approval and letters, trust account, refund on cancel, no automatic settlement. Verifier found one big miss: the prototype releases the prepayment payable before the procedure (payment received authorises the ACCPAY, payables run disburses with no gate, seeded paid prepayment disbursed Jul 16 for a Jul 24 procedure), which directly contradicts FT-06.5 and US-06.5.1, so those move from Missing to Contradicts. US-06.2.1 moved to Contradicts (retired category trigger) and US-06.5.3 to a low-confidence Partial. Dependencies: EP-04 (first-party Contracts), EP-05 (RVG groups), EP-08 (US-08.6.3 additional invoice, US-08.6.5 credit note; no credit-note kind on Invoice), EP-09 (draft pair timing, OQ-80), EP-12 (profile setting). Domain changes (drop PrepaymentDetail/split and prePaidByProcedure netting) need a PERSIST_VERSION bump and reseed of both Souter Fri 24 bookings (AM split unpaid, PM full paid; SEED_PREPAID_BOOKING_ID). Demo-guide S4 Beat 1 (prepayment warning on Souter Fri 24 AM) still works as a warning but its split-deposit wording and any 'Less pre-payment deposit' balance beat would break. Unpaid prepayment as a non-blocking warning (15a) is retained and fits. Open OQ-80, OQ-92, OQ-96, OQ-97 are not graded against; suggested designs only.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations: Structural: ListState needs DRAFT/ACTIVE/SUBMITTED/AUTHORISED. Today's DRAFT becomes ACTIVE; a new DRAFT (Draft List, no anaesthetist) needs List.anaesthetistId optional or a separate entity (FT-01.6). Sites touched: lifecycle.ts (submit/edit guards), canvas/seed (every generated canvas List is DRAFT, incl. free/holiday slots), selectors, mobile/web ListDetail canEdit, ForwardLists To-Do filter, BookingDetailBody/BtmCaptureBlock canEdit, admin ListDrawer, MoveBookingFlow, RolesInfo copy, ReassignListFlow candidate filter, demoTriggers registry, pwa/officeSimulation and officeStandIn, DemoData state filter. Needs PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13); tests assert on 'DRAFT'. Dependencies: FT-01.6/US-01.6.3 (Draft List and assign), US-01.3.2 (recurring booking creates ACTIVE), US-03.1.6 (past-work calendar and archive/search), US-03.1.9 (source wording, code, Contract), US-11.2.2/US-11.2.4 (payer, child-as-payer warning), US-11.4.1 (insurer Contracts), OQ-93 and OQ-31 (open). Correction to the first pass: a warning registry with stored office clearances already exists (domain/warnings, store/warnings.ts, one rule: prepaymentUnpaid, no clearance UI), so US-07.2.2's two warnings should be added as rules on that registry, with review reworked to use it instead of the ad hoc reviewFlags; also review shows only the primary Procedure's Contract. Authorise already runs the billing run synchronously, so 'finalised and sent to invoicing' equals authorise in the prototype. Web can scroll back to earlier unbilled Lists (From input, WeekStrip previous week), mobile cannot. Demo-guide impact: S2 Beat 4 (authorise a submitted List) and S3 Beat 1 rely on the List vanishing from anaesthetist views; guide text 'The List stays DRAFT' (~L157) becomes ACTIVE; the Review beat (~L196) changes if warnings and per-Procedure Contracts are added; an archive/search would add a beat after the List vanishes. The mobile main-view reshape would change S1 mobile list beats.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations:
Verified all 8 verdicts; none changed. Only size/surface tweaks (08.2.1 M to L, demo-guide surface on 08.4.5).

Shared new capability behind 08.6.2/6.3/6.4/6.5: credit-note and additional-invoice kinds on Invoice (today kind is only standard|prePayment), links to original invoice/Procedure, Procedure events (FT-03.7), negative payable/ACCPAY reversal plus Xero credit-note simulation, netting in the payables run and remittance (EP-10, US-10.2.5), a way to deliver credit notes, and an anaesthetist-side button on own invoiced Procedures in shared BookingDetailBody (mobile + web). AUTHORISED Lists are locked for every actor (lifecycle.ts editRefusal), so these actions need their own post-authorisation path. Build order: 6.2 core, 6.5, 6.3, then 6.4 as composition. Together about one XL block.

No internal ledger entity: prototype has BillingCase + Xero ACCREC/ACCPAY only; US-08.3.1 ledger pair and every 'linked payable' reversal depend on that.

Contract-decides-who-is-billed (08.2.1, FT-11.2, US-11.2.2, EP-04): prototype billingRoute + hospital/insurer default Type 1 contracts is the old RFP reading; catalogue (OQ-78 answered) has one No contract (RVG) default billing the payer on the Booking, and no route step. Joint EP-04/EP-11/EP-08 phase; touches counterpartyForProcedure, default contract seeding, office setup sheet, validateBookingForBilling.

Prepayment (08.2.2, EP-06): deposit/split and estimate-via-feeFor model contradicts US-06.2.2/06.4.1 (full fixed price from anaesthetist's own Contract, BTM reference only, nothing automatic). Fix jointly with US-06.x; bump PERSIST_VERSION for seed changes. The 'full' prepay already nets to $0 and raises no invoice, the one part that looks right.

Funder split (08.2.3): works only over stored billing lines in $, so ordinary RVG Procedures cannot be split from UI; needs $/% split directly on Contract line. 08.4.5: add anaesthetist GST number and anaesthetist-name masthead, keep provisional (OQ-29 open).

Demo-guide beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md and master-demo-guide.html): S3 Beat 1 (invoices, two-funder aside), S4 Beat 1 (prepayment, seeded $800 split), S4 post-op beat; new beats needed for credit-and-rebill and additional invoice.

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations: Only US-09.1.4 graded here. Core fix: remove the 5% service-fee netting so each ACCPAY equals its ACCREC value (agencyFee.ts, XeroAccPay shape, payables/disbursement maths, seed billing/history, web AccountsScreen service-fee column, selectors, tests, PERSIST_VERSION bump). Fee income moves to the monthly AA fee invoice run in EP-10 (US-10.3.1/10.3.3), so coordinate with that phase to avoid doing the removal twice. Then add a buyer-created tax invoice label and details block (anaesthetist name/GST number, AA as agent, GST treatment) to the simulator ACCPAY card with placeholder wording until OQ-29 settles. Ties to US-08.4.5 (agent wording on receivable), OQ-42/US-08.6.2 (negative invoice netted in next run). Demo-guide beats mentioning net payable or service fee in the Xero simulator would change.

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations: EP-10 payables work (US-10.2.1 correction, 10.2.6, 10.2.7) shares one design: remove the fee netting so the ACCPAY equals the receivable value (also DM-26 / US-10.3.1, OQ-60 open), then add a PaymentCycle/run entity (ISO week, status open/closed/scheduled/paid, held items) with an approval flag on payables. Key correction to the reviewer: the 5% AA service fee netted into the ACCPAY (agencyFee.ts, xeroHandoff.ts:234,270, seeds, Web Payments table, Xero sim, demo guide S4) contradicts EP-10/US-10.2.1 'exactly the amount received' and the 'BCTI same value as receivable' ruling; do the un-netting together with the US-10.3.x fee-invoice phase to avoid touching the same seed/UI twice. US-10.2.6 (Verify) and US-10.2.7 (Proposed) hinge on unresolved OQ-47, so build the cycle minimally and keep it replaceable. Cycle needs a stored shape change (PERSIST_VERSION bump, seed week stamps), and the demo clock is fixed at Tuesday 21 July 2026 so Friday/Monday/Tuesday beats need cycle-advance buttons placed on the Billing monitor only; demoTriggers.test.ts:54 forbids a 'payables' trigger label. Demo guide S4 (03-demo-script.md ~282-361) beats on payment received then Run payables need rewording for fee removal and the extra schedule step.

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: Structural: the prototype decides who is billed by a hand-set per-Procedure billingRoute (hospital / billableParty / insurer), with contract-holder billing implied by route 'hospital' (surgeon-, organisation- and billableParty-held Contracts bill the holder; seed Doyle bariatric bills the surgeon). The catalogue instead has the Contract decide (holder pays AA vs holder only sets price), a payer (name+email, defaulting to the patient) on the Booking, and a single No contract (RVG) default, with no per-hospital/insurer default Contracts. FT-11.2 and US-11.2.1/11.2.2 therefore need a domain change (Contract bills-holder flag, counterparty derivation, payer fields on Booking/Procedure) that cascades into invoiceBuild, validateBookingForBilling, seeds, Xero contact handoff (payer contact), the Insurers/Contract screens (remove protected defaults) and a PERSIST_VERSION bump. US-11.2.3 (payer email) and US-11.2.4 (under-18 warning) both depend on that payer model; US-11.2.4 also depends on a dashboard to-do list consuming the warning routine (US-13.7.2), which has no UI today (openWarnings etc. have no callers). NHI cluster: US-11.1.1 genuinely matches; US-11.1.4/11.1.5 need an Add NHI action, a missing-NHI anomaly/problem list and an authoriseList guard; Integration Monitor DataQualityCard is a reusable pattern. FT-11.3 (not graded here) is partially built: patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode plus a 'Prior balance' badge in Billing Monitor, but no cross-anaesthetist balance view, no alert threshold or due date. No patient master or billable-party screen exists in Admin MasterData. Open questions OQ-49, OQ-93, OQ-98 leave NHI keying and insurer Contract shape uncertain. Demo guide: beats using the Grace Park / Hana Park guardian Booking, insured reimbursement, prepayment (billableParty route) and PDF-dedupe/NHI-validator stay valid until the route becomes Contract-derived; keep PT0010 Noah Prescott as the problem-list seed.

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations: Only US-12.1.3 verified. It is the profile-side half of the prepayment flow (DM-19 in domain-model-delta; catch-up Phases 26/27 already planned to re-point detection at the prepaid set). Closing needs: Anaesthetist prepaid procedure/RVG-group fields (types.ts, seed, PERSIST_VERSION bump), a shared Profile screen (mobile More tab and web nav) with tick UI and a read-only price list from a seeded first-party individualAnaesthetist Contract, plus an admin edit-on-behalf path, and rewiring prepayment detection/amount (US-06.2.1, US-06.2.2). That profile screen would also serve sibling FT-12.1 items (unit value, GST period, contact, bank account, HPI), which currently have no anaesthetist-facing UI. Demo-guide S4 prepayment beats (Souter Fri 24 split-deposit and full seed bookings) change when the trigger moves. OQ-92, OQ-96 unresolved affect what the read-only list shows for unpriced prepaid procedures.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: EP-13 slice is largely unbuilt; all 10 reviewer verdicts upheld after re-checking code. Foundations absent: no Room entity, no surgeon profile or identifiers, no pairing data, no notification entity, no admin dashboard (admin lands on Day view). Surgeon is {id,name,specialty} and view-only in MasterData.tsx; it is a proper id master (pickers in EditListSheet/permanent lists use it), so FT-13.6 and US-13.6.2 are Partial. The warning routine (15a, one prepayment rule) exists but no UI calls openWarnings/warningsForList/clearWarning; the Booking banner reads prepaymentStatusFor directly, so FT-13.7 needs an admin to-do dashboard (likely US-13.7.2) and routing the banner through the routine. Dependencies: US-13.8.2 needs US-01.4.3 (anaesthetist moves own List) and FT-01.6 Draft List; US-13.8.1/13.8.2 share one notification slice and one demo button; US-13.6.3/13.6.4 share a pairing entity and feed US-01.3.5/01.3.6, and need an admin anaesthetist profile (US-12.1.4) and audit history (US-13.5.2); US-13.6.1 room email feeds US-02.3.3 and US-11.1.5; US-13.4.3 overlaps US-04.2.13 (OQ-100) and RVG/modifier masters (US-05.1.x view-only today), and its notes say no import screen is needed, so the loader demo is optional. Seed shape changes (rooms, surgeon fields, pairings, notifications) need a PERSIST_VERSION bump. Demo-script impact: S3 Beat 3 (illness cover, reassign whole List, 03-demo-script.md ~L202) changes if reassign gains the not-preferred soft warning grouping or an anaesthetist-side move posts a notification; S4 Beat 1 (prepayment warning) changes if banners route through the routine or an admin to-do list is added; the control panel needs a new 'Anaesthetist moves a List' trigger. Privacy of pairings makes a persona-switch demo beat natural (admin sees, anaesthetist sees nothing).

epics.title: Health systems integration

epics.observations: Only US-15.0.1 in scope (status Proposed, no open questions). Closing it takes two pieces of work. (1) Role-aware capture context: hide contract name, route chip and 'FIXED CONTRACT PRICE' from the anaesthetist but keep them for office. This overlaps the billing and contract epics, so check there first. (2) A small shared in-context help component (e.g. a '?' popover in src/shared/ui) used on mobile capture, admin Day view and admin Review. Neither touches the persisted store shape, so no PERSIST_VERSION bump. Demo-guide beats are unaffected, though any beat that shows the contract line on mobile would change. Training and docs are presenter-narrated.

items.summary: Submit/authorise/lock flow works, but List has three states (DRAFT/SUBMITTED/AUTHORISED); no ACTIVE, no Draft List (no anaesthetist), and today's DRAFT is what the catalogue now calls ACTIVE.
items.requirement_says: Four List states: DRAFT (Draft List, no anaesthetist), ACTIVE (all five of pairing; anaesthetist edits and submits), SUBMITTED (anaesthetist edit access removed, office review), AUTHORISED (locks Bookings, Procedures, selected Contracts; hands to billing). An ACTIVE List moved/withdrawn/clashed becomes a Draft List again.
items.prototype_does: ListState = DRAFT | SUBMITTED | AUTHORISED (types.ts:46). DRAFT means 'anaesthetist-editable' and is set on every generated canvas List incl. free/holiday/unavailable slots (canvas.ts:108). submitList (DRAFT to SUBMITTED, completion-gated, lifecycle.ts:210) and authoriseList (office only, SUBMITTED only, emits listAuthorised to billing run, :277) work; edit rights follow state; AUTHORISED locks Bookings. Reassign/move leave free slots, not Draft Lists.
missing_or_wrong: No ACTIVE state; the old DRAFT is the new ACTIVE (name collision with the new DRAFT meaning)
No Draft List: List.anaesthetistId is mandatory, no unassigned List entity (FT-01.6 dependency)
No ACTIVE to Draft List transition on move/withdraw/reschedule clash
UI prints raw 'DRAFT': admin ListDrawer header (ListDrawer.tsx:51), RolesInfo copy 'while the List is DRAFT' (RolesInfo.tsx:24,34), DemoData state filter
ACTIVE not derived from the five-part pairing (free/holiday/unavailable slots and private Lists with no surgeon, util.ts:111 'Surgeon not yet assigned', all carry DRAFT)
evidence: searched: 'ACTIVE' as list state, Draft List, unassigned in src -> none (only SW worker state and a routes comment)

Contradicts holds (DRAFT used where catalogue means ACTIVE). Added DemoData filter to the raw-DRAFT sites.

items.requirement_says: On AUTHORISED the engine reads each locked Procedure and its Contract, applies multi-procedure rules, nets prepayment, creates linked receivable/payable in its own ledger (system of record), generates and sends invoices, mirrors to Xero. Parallel-run reconciliation is a delivery constraint.

Anaesthetist views read BillingCase/invoice/receipt records. items.summary: Core Xero mirror (ACCREC + draft ACCPAY pair, webhook + daily poll, hidden-ID contacts, archiving) is built; the epic's resilience and divergence discussion (async queue, auto-retry with backoff, alerting, Xero-side void/amend drift) is not represented.
items.requirement_says: Dedicated Xero org under the engine (not system of record) mirrors an ACCREC and draft ACCPAY per ledger pair, detects payment by webhook plus daily poll, uses hidden-ID contacts. Proposed resilience: async processing, durable queue with exponential-backoff retry, idempotency, handling of engine/Xero divergence (voided/amended in Xero, payment against a credited invoice), failure/recovery testing.
items.prototype_does: Handoff is synchronous inside one mutate after the billing run. A single armed fault (settings.failNextHandoff) records handoffFailure on the case, shown in Billing Monitor with a manual 'Resolve & retry'. Webhook and poll are simulated. No queue, no automatic retry/backoff, no outage or alerting, no drift detection. XeroAccRec 'voided' is typed and rendered but nothing ever sets it. Idempotency is present (accRecId no-op, per-payment key).
missing_or_wrong: No Xero outage / slow-API simulation showing the user flow unblocked while events queue
No automatic retry with exponential backoff, retry count or next-attempt visibility (manual Resolve & retry only)
No alerting of persistent handoff failure beyond the Billing Monitor chip
No divergence handling: an invoice voided/amended directly in Xero is never detected; no payment-against-credited-invoice ordering case
'voided' ACCREC status exists in types/UI but is never driven
Epic frames the engine ledger as system of record (US-08.3.2); prototype has no internal ledger, BillingCase + XeroAccRec/AccPay hold the money (dependency on EP-08)
evidence: searched: backoff|outage|queue|nextAttempt in src/store and src/apps/demo -> only integration (HL7) retry, none for Xero
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Simulate Xero outage' on the Xero sim (/demo/xero) and on /demo/control: while on, new handoffs and payment syncs go into a visible pending queue showing attempt count and backoff timer, while the user flow (authorise a List) continues unblocked. 'Restore Xero' drains the queue and pairs appear with no duplicates. Plus 'Void this invoice in Xero' on the pair detail so the next poll flags the mismatch for office resolution. Shell has no screen-contextual slot for these today, so they live on the Xero sim pair detail / control panel.
items.verify_note: Re-searched store and demo for queue/backoff/retry/void handling: only manual handoff retry exists; 'voided' has a label render but no writer. Verdict upheld. Added the system-of-record/ledger dependency point.

A fault leaves the invoice standing with handoffFailure and no half pair; Billing Monitor Xero stage shows done/partial/failed per List and per Card with Resolve & retry (idempotent re-handoff); simulator lists the pairs.

One per procedure, same value as its receivable (OQ-42, Notes #18/#41). Final wording waits on the accountant and IRD's new name (OQ-29, still Open).

Wording is unresolved (OQ-29 Open), so a placeholder label is needed and the requirement is Proposed.

$500 + $5 x 40 = $700 criterion cannot be produced
Seeded history needs a month of BCTIs per anaesthetist to make the run meaningful (BCTIs = ACCPAYs; paid-only needs paid status, available via XeroAccPay.status 'paid')

items.summary: Who is billed is a hand-picked per-Procedure route (hospital / billableParty / insurer), not decided by the Contract; a surgeon-held fixed-price Contract bills the surgeon, where the catalogue bills the Booking payer (patient).
items.requirement_says: Contract decides: holder pays AA -> holder's billable party; otherwise (price-only holder, anaesthetist's own Contract, No contract RVG) -> the payer on the Booking, defaulting to the patient with name and email, editable by office or anaesthetist.
items.prototype_does: counterpartyForProcedure bills the insurer on the insurer route, the patient or a BillableParty on the billableParty route, else the resolved contract's holder (hospital, surgeon, organisation, billableParty). Seed Doyle bariatric Type 3 (surgeon-held) is billed to the surgeon. No 'holder pays AA' flag on Contract, no No-contract(RVG) default, no payer name/email on the Booking.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: surgeon-held fixed-price Contract (seed CT-DOYLE-BAR, route hospital) bills the surgeon, catalogue bills the Booking payer
Contract has no 'holder pays AA' vs 'holder only sets price' attribute; route is a manual per-Procedure choice
No default 'No contract (RVG)' Contract billing the payer; fallback is per-hospital/insurer protected default Type 1 (catalogue: no hospital/insurer defaults)
Payer is held per Procedure as optional BillableParty override, not name+email on the Booking; not prefilled from patient; anaesthetist cannot change it on an existing Booking (office-only sheet)
No billable-party reference table that Contracts point to (draft design)
Insurance indication on Booking (OQ-93) not stored; insurerId is informational on hospital route only
evidence: aa-prototype/src/shared/flows/EditBillingSetupSheet.tsx:126-170 (route + payer select), :62 guardian form name/relationship/phone only

items.summary: upsertPatient dedupes on a validated, normalised NHI (either format), reusing and enriching the existing record regardless of name/address changes; record holds demographics, NZHIS L4 ethnicity, contact.

Add Booking confirmation says 'Linked to an existing patient record by NHI. No duplicate was created.' Patient keyed by hidden ID with NHI attribute (consistent with OQ-49 proposal).

items.title: Patient record keyed on NHI

items.summary: Both NHI formats validated (current mod-11, new mod-23) and enforced on every intake path; Admin Validators tab shows valid current, valid new and wrong-check rejection.
items.requirement_says: Validate current AAANNNC and new AAANNAX NHIs, never assume numeric/sequential, reject invalid before entering the system. Text says 'modulus 24' for the current format.
items.prototype_does: validateNhi picks format by character class, checks digit/letter, rejects I/O and remainder-0. Called from upsertPatient, ingestPdfRow, ManualCardForm lookup and the Admin NHI validator. Deliberately mod-11 (RFP's own example only validates under mod-11), documented in code and UI copy.
items.verify_note: Re-read nhi.ts and callers. Only tension is the catalogue's literal 'modulus 24' wording vs the prototype's mod-11 (a settled Decisions-log ruling); flag to catalogue owners, not a prototype gap. Not a branded value object, irrelevant to the demo.
items.title: Dual-format NHI validation

items.summary: A provisional patient can be created without NHI and shows 'NHI pending', but the NHI cannot be attached later, nothing flags an anomaly, and authorising the List is not blocked.

Seed has provisional Noah Prescott (PT0010). EditPatientSheet/editPatient cover name, dob, phone, email, address only; authoriseList has no NHI guard; reviewFlags has no NHI flag.
missing_or_wrong: No way to attach the NHI to an existing pending patient (PatientEditPatch excludes nhi; EditPatientSheet has no NHI field)

items.verify_note: Re-read intake.ts, lifecycle.ts, reviewFlags.ts, EditPatientSheet; all gaps real. Nothing implemented is wrong versus the stated working assumption, so Partial not Contradicts.

Billing target not derived from the Contract (manual route)

Billing mirror holds invoice totals and receivedAmount per case (caseOutstandingAmount).

No per-patient invoice list across anaesthetists

items.title: Patient outstanding bills view

items.prototype_does: patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode is true when the patient has another non-cancelled Booking whose billing case still owes money. Seed: Sarah Mitchell carries an unpaid prior episode.
missing_or_wrong: MISSING: alert at Booking create/match (AddBookingFlow, phone advice, hospital download, PDF ingest) and on the Booking screen
MISSING: mild vs strong by age of oldest unpaid invoice from invoice date, 90-day default
MISSING: admin-editable threshold (no setting or UI)
MISSING: credit-balance mild alert (no patient credit concept)
MISSING: billable-party condition (check is by patient on any route)
MISSING: clearable warning via warnings framework / to-do list (US-13.7.x)
evidence: searched: patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode|Prior balance in src -> only selectors and BillingMonitorScreen

items.summary: Insurers master exists with an accepts-direct-claims flag, but it is view and toggle only, and flipping the flag auto-creates a protected default Type 1 insurer Contract, which the catalogue now removes; insurance indication (OQ-93) and plain-RVG insurer Contracts (OQ-98) are absent.

Catalogue (US-04.3.3) says there are no hospital, insurer or procedure default Contracts.

Insurer route validator rejects non-direct insurers. Insurer chosen per Procedure.

Model difference: insurer held on the Procedure (insurerId) with explicit route and category; catalogue says neither Patient nor Booking holds an insurer and the Contract defines who pays (OQ-55, OQ-67)

summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype is still the July RFP model. The EP-01 canvas, billing-run isolation, audit, NHI validation, per-anaesthetist unit value, GST-exclusive maths and the 15a warning registry match the catalogue. Almost everything else sits one design generation behind. Across the ~190 graded items there are only a handful of Matches (US-05.2.1, 05.2.6, 05.2.7, 05.3.5, 05.4.2, US-11.1.1, FT-03.2) and a large share of Contradicts: not missing features but the old design standing where a new one is required. The gap is structural, not cosmetic. Five foundations (Slot/Draft List, Contract/Procedure model, ledger payable, prepayment model, intake matching) must be rebuilt before most screens can be touched. Verified counts: 46 data-model deltas (DM-13 to DM-38, none refuted) and 34 reverse-check findings (RV-nn). Rough total: well over 40 XL/L blocks, but they collapse into about 8 shared builds (below). Do not sum the item sizes: many items share one build.

### Themes

1. **Contract decides price and payer; route and Type 1/2/3 go (XL, the largest).** One Contract per Procedure, holder pays AA or Booking payer billed, one holderless No contract (RVG), no hospital/insurer defaults, dated versions, lines per procedure, AA code, snapshot at AUTHORISED. Items: EP-04, FT-04.1 to FT-04.3, US-04.1.1 to US-04.1.5, US-04.2.x, US-04.3.x, FT-11.2, US-11.2.1, US-11.4.1, US-08.2.1, US-03.4.1, US-03.6.1. DM-48, 03, 04, 05, 06, 13, 14, 16, 18. RV-01, 08, 29, 33, 34.

2. **Procedure master, RVG groups and capture rework (XL).** Procedure master (~400 rows), body-area hierarchy, two-tab picker, base-unit precedence (line > procedure > group), modifiers as records with explanations, ASA as an ordinary modifier, locked age/included modifiers, real RVG values, out-of-range base warns instead of blocks, rate x time removed, billing lines get dates, source wording kept as received. Items: US-05.1.1 to US-05.1.6, FT-05.1, FT-03.3, US-03.3.1, 03.3.4, 03.3.6, 03.3.8, US-03.1.9, US-02.5.7. DM-13, 07, 10, 12, 15. RV-02, 04, 23, 24, 35, 38.

3. **Pricing precedence and adjustment gating (L).** Anaesthetist price/discount only on No contract and first-party Contracts; office override separate; fixed rate and fixed discount independent; $0 gives a no-charge invoice; Type 3 always prices from its own line; modifier split above four. Items: FT-05.2, FT-05.3, US-05.2.5, US-05.3.1, US-05.4.1, US-05.4.3, FT-03.5, US-03.5.1. DM-50, 09, 11. RV-11.

4. **Slot, Draft List and List lifecycle (XL).** List.anaesthetistId optional, DRAFT/ACTIVE/SUBMITTED/AUTHORISED (old DRAFT becomes ACTIVE), Draft List admin page, statuses as master data, mark-unavailable forces return or assign, anaesthetist moves own List, recurring booking on unavailable Slot drafts instead of dropping, tiers and private preference pairings. Items: EP-01, FT-01.3, FT-01.6, US-01.2.2, 01.3.5, 01.3.6, 01.4.5, 01.4.6, 01.5.5, 01.6.2, 01.6.3, EP-07, FT-07.1, FT-13.6, US-13.6.1 to 13.6.4. DM-02 to DM-05, 27, 28, 29. RV-14, 15, 30, 36.

5. **Hospital intake via a matching screen (L, shared build).** Staged import rows, match/create/Draft/reject, field-difference approval, unmatched queue; nothing auto-applies. Items: FT-02.1, US-02.1.1 to 02.1.5, US-02.3.1, 02.3.3, 02.4.1. DM-34, 31. RV-05, 06, 13, 26, 28. HL7/FHIR/dead-letter tooling is Future, so keep the existing simulator but demote it.

6. **Prepayment replaced (XL).** Profile prepaid set, fixed full price from the anaesthetist's first-party Contract, auto-draft at setup with admin approval and letter, trust account held until procedure done, refund on cancel, no automatic settlement, no deposit. Items: EP-06, FT-06.1 to 06.5, US-06.x, US-12.1.3, US-08.2.2. DM-19, 34, 35. RV-09. The payable is currently released before the procedure (FT-06.5, US-06.5.1): a real contradiction, not just a missing feature.

7. **Ledger payable, credit/additional invoices and payment cycle (XL combined).** Promote the payable into the ledger (DM-22), remove the 5% fee netting (DM-26, RV-07, US-09.1.4, US-10.2.1), credit-and-rebill, additional invoices, split, Procedure events (DM-17, 37, 38), weekly cycle and approval (DM-25, US-10.2.6/10.2.7), cash-basis GST (DM-29, RV-32). Items: EP-08 (US-08.6.2 to 08.6.5), EP-09, EP-10, US-08.4.5. RV-10.

8. **Admin oversight: warnings dashboard, notifications, NHI problem list, balances (M to L).** Admin to-do list on the existing 15a registry plus new rules (child payer, insurer-no-Contract, out-of-range, patient balance), notification pool, NHI add/block/problem list, ledger positions without ageing. Items: FT-13.7, FT-13.8, US-13.8.1, 13.8.2, US-11.1.4, 11.1.5, 11.2.3, 11.2.4, US-07.2.2. DM-30, 26, 40, 44. RV-19, 21.

9. **Past work, review and anaesthetist app polish (M).** Archive/search, scroll-back on mobile, prepaid amount display, Contract/source stack. Items: US-03.1.6, US-03.1.8, FT-07.4, US-07.4.1, US-07.4.2.

### Structural first

Land these before screen work, in this order, with one PERSIST_VERSION bump per batch and a reseed:

1. **DM-52 + DM-03 + DM-02 (List/Slot/Draft)**, as one change. The DRAFT-to-ACTIVE rename collides with the new DRAFT meaning; doing it piecemeal mixes the old and new vocabularies (RV-36). Gates themes 4, 5, and every Draft List creation path (US-01.6.1, US-02.1.2).
2. **DM-13 (RVG groups and procedures), then DM-48 to DM-10 (holder, Contract, lines, No contract (RVG), Procedure.contractId)**. Every pricing, capture, billing, prepayment and review screen reads these. Remove route, patientPaymentCategory and per-hospital defaults here (RV-08, RV-33), not later. Bundle EP-04 and EP-05 stories; XL sizes are lower bounds.
3. **DM-11 (payer on Booking)** with DM-10; it feeds US-11.2.2 to 11.2.4, billing counterparty and prepayment detection (DM-19).
4. **DM-22 (ledger payable) with DM-26 (drop fee netting)**, once, so seed and Xero view change a single time. Precedes DM-21, 37, 38, 41.
5. **DM-51 (source texts)** alongside DM-13: touches every intake path and the Booking stack.
6. Cheap early additions, independent: DM-41 (notification pool), DM-32 (rooms, contacts, profile fields), DM-54 pairings and tier.

DM-08 (snapshot at AUTHORISED) must follow DM-07/06/08/16. Fixing the late-bound resolver (RV-01) is the real purpose of the snapshot, so do not defer it.

### Things to remove or rework (reverse check)

- **Remove:** Copy a Booking (RV-03, 8 files plus the master demo guide HTML); the ACC review flag (RV-20, only the flag).
- **Hide from demo or badge:** Integrations tooling as lead product (RV-05); live HL7/FHIR drip and S1 built on it (RV-06, rework); photo of paper card (RV-25); Surgeon PDF tab (RV-26, supersedes the Phase 14 decision); automated S13 to S15 hospital changes (RV-28); dashboard Productivity and Leave (RV-18).
- **Rework (retired or superseded behaviour still built):** route/Type 1/2/3 (RV-08), default Contracts (RV-33), ordinal second-procedure pricing (RV-34), rate x time and Method 3 (RV-24), P1 absorption and its wrong seed codes (RV-23), ranged-base hard bound (RV-04), ASA pre-fill (RV-35), invented modifier table (RV-38), prepayment model (RV-09), 5% fee (RV-07), cover marker (RV-15), conflict-flag on mark-unavailable (RV-30), Slot/List single status (RV-14), per-line funder allocation (RV-37), ageing buckets (RV-19), prior-balance tag (RV-21), write-through admin edits (RV-31), receipt-based GST (RV-32), post-op addendum Booking (RV-10), stale 'assumption' copy (RV-17).
- Lower confidence (rests on Verify/Open): RV-02, 07, 09, 10, 13, 21, 32, 35, 37. Label these "simplification until AA answers".
- Catalogue cleanups to flag: US-01.4.6 AC3 conflicts with US-06.3.5 (treat US-06.3.5 as current); US-05.2.3 vs US-05.1.4 on P1; US-03.3.7 retirement note vs US-03.3.6; domain-model still lists copy and photo as Booking sources.

### Demo impact (S1 to S5)

- **S1:** Beat 1 (MSG-STG-1001 creates a Booking directly) changes to "Receive hospital download" into the matching screen; its caveat becomes the main path (RV-06, RV-13). Beat 3 changes with the procedure picker, ASA/modifier explanation and the DRAFT-to-ACTIVE wording ("List stays DRAFT").
- **S2:** Beat 2 (phone-book Sharma's Free List) changes with the 'as given' field and, in the new model, the status/booking blur (RV-14). Beat 3 (reassign Rutherford to Sharma, vacated slot) is replaced by return-to-office then assign a Draft List with preference warnings; "vacated slot" wording goes. Beat 4 (authorise) unchanged in action but review gains warnings, per-Procedure Contracts and payer. Add a Draft Lists beat and a notification beat.
- **S3:** Beat 1 pinned figures (AA-2026-0002 $396.18; Prentice $152.38/$91.43) move with units, seed codes and modifier values; two-funder aside is redone. Beat 3 (payment and disbursement) loses the 5% fee and nets differently; Beat 4 contract narrative changes.
- **S4:** Beat 1 prepayment warning survives but split-deposit wording and the deduction beat break; Beat 2 post-op addendum becomes an event; Beat 3 billing-failure trigger (end-dating COS ACC contract) needs a new failure scenario (e.g. Booking with no Contract); Beat 4 dead-letter and mapping fix is Future-scope, drop or badge; Beat 5 partial payment loses the net amount. New beats: credit-and-rebill, additional invoice, trust release.
- **S5:** Beat 1 audit (compliance edits on Chen) changes with modifier explanations; Beat 3 stays; Beat 4 (edit Health NZ end date) becomes new version plus snapshot view.
- Cheat sheet 'Contracts' (Type 1/2/3, protected default) and route chips must be rewritten, as must master-demo-guide.html.

### Demo-trigger buttons

The owner's pattern: screen-contextual buttons in the top control area, shown only on the screen where the effect is visible. About 38 graded items carry a trigger note; roughly 20 need a genuinely new control, the rest reuse existing ones (clock advance, fire-hospital-message, S4 jump, Payment received, Run payables) or need only seed changes. Main clusters:

- **Hospital intake:** "Receive hospital download" / "Sync from hospitals" on the matching screen (FT-02.1, US-02.1.1, 02.1.3, 02.1.5), plus a hospital list arriving with an NHI (US-11.1.5).
- **Draft Lists:** "Surgeon room request", "Recurring booking hits an unavailable day", "Anaesthetist moves a List (6am)" (FT-01.6, FT-13.8, US-13.8.1, 13.8.2).
- **Prepayment and trust:** release payable, cancel and refund, approve with letter (FT-06.5, US-06.3.1, 06.3.6, 06.5.1, 06.5.2, 06.5.4).
- **Credit and additional invoices:** credit-and-rebill, additional invoice, split, credit note (US-08.6.2 to 08.6.5); these are real product actions on the invoice or Booking page, not control-panel items, with Xero view showing the pair.
- **Payment cycle:** close week, flag anomaly, build schedule, approve (FT-10.2, US-10.2.1, 10.2.6, 10.2.7), placed on the Billing monitor only. demoTriggers.test.ts:54 forbids a 'payables' trigger label.
- **Warnings and problem lists:** make-child-payer, hospital list with NHI (US-11.2.4, 11.1.4, FT-13.7). Several others are "seed it" (US-07.2.2, US-03.1.8).

### Uncertainty

Unsafe or provisional to build until answered:
- **OQ-89** (price stacking, time band on fixed lines), **OQ-90** (does the modifier split apply), **OQ-95** (ASA and age bands), **OQ-101/OQ-88** (range holding, group codes), **OQ-103** (general procedure naming), **OQ-99** (blank procedure): sit inside themes 1 to 3. Build the structure, keep rule details replaceable.
- **OQ-93** (where insurance indication lives) and **OQ-98** (plain RVG insurer Contracts): affect DM-12, US-07.2.2, US-11.4.1.
- **OQ-80, 92, 96, 97** (prepayment pair timing, unpriced prepaid procedures, price lock, partial credit): theme 6 design is suggested only; FT-06.5 and US-06.5.x are Verify.
- **OQ-47, OQ-60, OQ-29** (payment cycle and BCTI, fee invoice, GST agency wording): US-10.2.6 Verify, US-10.2.7 Proposed, fee invoice rests on Verify FT-10.3. Build minimally with placeholder wording.
- **OQ-81 part 3, OQ-84, OQ-85, OQ-86, OQ-79** (sickness, vacated Slot, single Booking move, notifications): US-01.4.7 and 13.8.x partly provisional.
- **OQ-102** (tier and pairing names, US-13.6.4/01.3.6 Verify), **OQ-13** (hospital file format, keep fields generic), **OQ-49** (NHI keying; blocking rule is a working assumption), **OQ-100** (loader).
- **OQ-64 / storage:** the Slot/List split is logical; storage is for the developers, but a Draft List forces some separation.

Where a gap rests on a Verify, Proposed or Open item, build behind the phase and mark the output as a provisional reading rather than settled behaviour.

dataModelDeltas.title: RVG groups, body sections and a curated procedure list replace the flat RVG code table and free-text procedure description
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Base units live on the RVG group (NZSA as published plus AA's own, not marked AA-sourced per US-05.1.1 note): unique system code, body section, base units above 0, modifier units default 0. Beneath sits a curated procedure list (about 400 rows): worded for the invoice, exactly one RVG group, optional own base/modifier units, no nesting, no prices; every group has a general procedure. Two-tab picker (Procedures, RVG codes). Seeded once from spreadsheets then hand-maintained. Open: OQ-88, OQ-101, OQ-103.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Only RvgCode (types.ts:550): code, description, flat anatomicalSite, baseUnits single|range, absorbsModifierCodes; about 34 demo rows. Procedure stores free-text description and a scalar rvgBaseCode (types.ts:453). No body section, procedure list, general procedure, AA groups or group modifier units.

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract holder becomes a master record (third or first party, bills-holder flag, billable party, anaesthetist)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Contract belongs to one holder: insurer, hospital, surgeon or rooms (third party, locked prices) or an anaesthetist (first party, offered only on their Bookings). Holder records whether it pays AA itself (billable party record required and billed) or only sets the price (Booking payer billed). A holder holds many Contracts. Office creates first-party Contracts from the anaesthetist's price list (OQ-91).

Contract has holderType (hospital|insurer|surgeon|organisation|billableParty) + holderId into disjoint tables (types.ts:195-216); first party only as ContractScope individualAnaesthetist (types.ts:207); no bills-holder flag, holder always billed (invoiceBuild.ts:192). Insurer.acceptsDirectClaims gates only the Insurer route (types.ts:166). The 'organisation' (ContractHolderOrganisation) and 'billableParty' holder types have no catalogue counterpart.

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract becomes a dated, versioned record with an AA code; Type 1/2/3, scope, default flag and Method 3 gate go
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract is a dated version: start, optional end, review date, link to the version it replaces; lines share the dates; a price review makes a new version, the version in force on the procedure date prices it, old Bookings keep old prices; versions can be entered ahead of start. Unique short AA code (OQ-66). Holders, not categories, shape the list (third party, first party, No contract (RVG)); category headings in the picker are not settled. Admins create, edit, version, retire; anaesthetists never.
