dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Draft overstated 'no categories beyond...': the domain model says category headings are unsettled. Seed count corrected to 12 Contracts. US-04.1.2 confirms admin-only editing.

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract line (one per procedure, carrying only what it sets) replaces ContractPrice
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: At most one line per procedure per Contract; a combination Contract has a line under each parent procedure. A line carries only what it sets: fixed price (ex GST), fixed rate, fixed discount, base/modifier units, optional holder code and description (searchable), possibly a time band (OQ-89). Blank inherits, 0 is a value. No RVG mapping, add-on flag, quantity rule, price tier or line date; no group line.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ContractPrice (types.ts:250): contractId, optional rvgBaseCode, surgeonId, procedureOrdinal, price; Type 3 only, most-specific-wins (contracts.ts:77), BTM fallback when none match; 3 seeded rows. Rate/discount live on Contract.type2Detail (types.ts:212). No holder code, units override or time band.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replaces masters.contractPrices and matchContractPrice. Surgeon- and ordinal-specific prices become surgeon-held Contracts and plain lines. Picker (DM-10) and resolver (DM-43) read lines. Seed prices and Master Data rewritten. After DM-13 and DM-07.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue items Confirmed/Verify; ContractPrice shape and 3 seed rows confirmed in code.

dataModelDeltas.title: One stored No contract (RVG) replaces the protected default Type 1 per hospital and direct-billing insurer
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Exactly one No contract (RVG): no holder, no lines, never expires, found by flag, offered first for every procedure, bills the payer on the Booking. No hospital, insurer or per-procedure default Contracts; nothing derived from the List's location. FT-04.4, US-04.4.1, US-04.4.2 are Retired (OQ-78).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Protected default Type 1 per hospital and per direct-claims insurer (6 seeded), created atomically (mastersActions.ts:45-150), protected from delete/end-dating (contractActions.ts), and used as fallback when a negotiated Contract is expired/absent (invoiceBuild.ts:114). Billable Party route resolves with no Contract.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Was an aligned feature in the earlier pass, now a removal. Delete per-holder invariants, fallback rules and tests; add one flagged Contract and the offered-first rule; payer-on-Booking billing replaces the Billable Party route (DM-11). Ship with DM-07.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Retired items used only as the boundary explaining the removal; US-04.3.3 (Confirmed) is the live basis. Seed shows 6 default Contracts.

dataModelDeltas.title: Each Procedure selects exactly one Contract at booking setup; the billing route and billing-time Contract resolution disappear
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Procedure references exactly one Contract before the Booking can be completed. Admin sets it at booking setup (mandatory); the anaesthetist may change procedure or Contract until submit with no reason, audited and flagged at office review; change refreshes starting units/fixed price and clears a typed price if not adjustable. Picker: No contract (RVG) first, then Contracts with a line for the procedure, valid on the date, whose holder fits the List's hospital/surgeon/rooms and (first party) the Booking's anaesthetist. The engine resolves no route or payer.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure carries billingRoute (hospital|billableParty|insurer, types.ts:418), optional governingContractId, insurerId, billablePartyId, patientPaymentCategory, prepaymentDetail, accRelated, billingReference (types.ts:453). Route set explicitly (validator fails unset, validateBookingForBilling.ts:125); Contract resolved at billing time from holder+date+default fallback (invoiceBuild.ts:114), not locked. Only the office edits billing setup (OfficeBillingSetup.tsx, rendered for office actor only); anaesthetist read-only.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Central relationship change: Procedure.contractId replaces route, governing Contract, insurer and payment category. 24 non-test files reference governingContractId/billingRoute (validator, invoice build, billing run, review, capture UI, seed). Anaesthetist gains a Contract/procedure picker; review gains a Contract-change flag. Needs DM-13 to DM-49; unblocks DM-43, DM-50, DM-08, DM-11, DM-20. Blank-procedure setup is OQ-99.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Substance confirmed. The validator cite was :104 (function signature); the route check is :125. Office-only billing setup confirmed (BookingDetailBody renders OfficeBillingSetup for the office actor).

dataModelDeltas.title: Starting units resolve through Contract line, procedure, then RVG group; out-of-range base units warn instead of fail
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Base and modifier units start from the first layer that sets them: Contract line, procedure, RVG group (blank inherits, 0 is a value); fixed price/rate/discount from the line only; value and layer recorded; re-runs on procedure/Contract change. For a ranged code the anaesthetist picks the exact figure and may enter any value; out-of-range is accepted with an after-procedure warning (OQ-62, OQ-56). Range holding is OQ-101.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: resolveBtm (fee.ts:58) takes base units from the single RvgCode row (single, or range via baseUnitsSelected) with captured override provenance; no Contract/procedure layer, no layer recorded. Validator flags a missing/out-of-range selection as a billing failure, not a warning (validateBookingForBilling.ts:152-165).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Pure domain/billing change plus tests and a source-layer field on captured units; capture UI shows and refreshes starting values. Depends on DM-13 and DM-09; feeds the warning rule in DM-31.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Substance confirmed (OQ-56 and OQ-62 Answered). Validator cite corrected from :104 to :152-165.

dataModelDeltas.title: Pricing follows one precedence with fixed-rate and fixed-discount Contracts and a recorded price source; Type 2/3 pricing goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: First that applies: office override, anaesthetist typed price (adjustable Contracts only), Contract fixed price (BTM reference only), else BTM x Contract rate or the anaesthetist's unit value, less the Contract's locked discount and/or the anaesthetist's own (stacking is OQ-89). 0 gives a no-charge invoice. Engine rejects a typed price on a non-adjustable Contract and missing BTM with no fixed price. Fixed rate and fixed discount are new. All prices ex GST.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: feeFor (fee.ts:180): Type 1 units x unit value; Type 2 agreed rate or percent folded into a derived rate; Type 3 fixed ContractPrice else BTM fallback; non-RVG lines; then the typed priceOverride last. No recorded price source, no adjustable gate, no separate discount step.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Rewrite pure fee path and Vitest suite; FeeResult gains priceSource and a rejection path. Invoice line text can no longer be the only snapshot (DM-08). Depends on DM-09, DM-14. Multi-procedure rule status is OQ-90 (DM-15).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Precedence matches domain-model section 3; feeFor confirmed at fee.ts:180. Stacking is explicitly open (OQ-89).

dataModelDeltas.title: Price changes split into an anaesthetist adjustment (gated by the Contract) and an office override
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Anaesthetist adjustment: typed price or percentage discount with required reason, only on No contract (RVG) and first-party Contracts; third-party price read-only, fixed discount shown locked; cleared if the Contract changes to a non-adjustable one; BTM still recorded. Office override at review: percent, amount or final fixed fee with reason, always allowed. Both audited.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: One optional Procedure.priceOverride (types.ts:443): fixedFee|dollarAdjustment|percentAdjustment + reason, written by anyone with edit rights via editProcedure (lifecycle.ts:438, guarded only by editRefusal). No actor distinction, Contract gating or clearing; OverrideCard and PriceOverrideSheet drive it.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Procedure gains two fields/records; adjustable test derived from holder party type and No contract (RVG); validator and both UIs gate on it. Depends on DM-48, DM-07. Price change on a prepaid procedure is OQ-96.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: editProcedure confirmed to patch any field for any actor with edit rights; catalogue items Confirmed/Verify.

dataModelDeltas.title: Modifiers become per-Procedure records with explanations; age and included modifiers are locked; ASA is just a modifier
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: System applies only non-removable modifiers: age (A1/A2 from DOB on procedure date) and any modifier included in a code's base units (P1 on all Neuro H7A-H9b and Spine S1-S10), shown selected at 0 units and locked. All others optional from the RVG table plus AA's own, itemised, each needing a short explanation. Nothing pre-filled, ASA included. Some values are not plain numbers. Implies a modifier record per Procedure (OQ-94, OQ-95).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure.selectedModifierCodes string[] plus separate asaClass seeding its AS code (fee.ts:79-84; types.ts:440). modifierUnits sums plain numbers and zeroes RvgCode.absorbsModifierCodes with a refusal caption (modifierUnits.ts:58). No explanation field, no DOB-driven age modifier (A1/A2 are ordinary chips), no per-Procedure modifier record.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New record (procedure, modifier, units, explanation, locked reason); modifier master gains non-numeric values and AA codes; asaClass/absorbs/refusal path go; completion adds the explanation rule; capture sheet rebuilt (about 10 non-test files read selectedModifierCodes). Needs DM-13; feeds DM-15.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-05.1.4 and the domain model agree on locked P1; the stale 'base never absorbs a modifier' note on retired US-05.2.3 is logged as a catalogue contradiction. OQ-95 (ASA pre-fill, bands) is still open.

dataModelDeltas.title: Multi-procedure rule: one primary flag, time on every procedure, modifier units split above four, no Contract-specific ordinals
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Exactly one primary Procedure per Booking, settable by anyone with edit rights. Base units only on the primary; time units on every Procedure from its own times (tiers held as data, part interval rounded up); modifier units all on primary when total is 4 or fewer, else equal split with remainder to primary. Contract-specific second-procedure rules Retired (US-04.2.5, US-05.3.4). Whether the rule applies at all is OQ-90 (Verify).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Base-on-primary and time-on-every-procedure already match (additional procedures yield time units only, fee.ts:107). Differs: Procedure.isAdditional boolean (types.ts:453) rather than a settable primary, all modifiers on the first procedure, ordinal-keyed fixed prices (ContractPrice.procedureOrdinal; fee.ts:212), time tiers as module constants (timeUnits.ts:13-31).
dataModelDeltas.impact: isAdditional becomes isPrimary (14 non-test files); modifier-total allocation step is pure; ordinal pricing and seed rows go; tiers become data. Needs DM-44 for the modifier total. Small if built once OQ-90 is read as 'the rule applies'.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Draft implied the whole rule differs; code shows base and time allocation already match. Real delta is the modifier split above 4, settable primary, ordinal-price removal, tiers as data. Retired US-04.2.5/US-05.3.4 used only as boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: Rate x time billing and the Method 3 individual-arrangement gate are removed; other billing lines remain with their own dates
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Rate x time capture is Retired (US-03.3.7); US-03.3.6 states a fixed-rate Contract prices the whole Procedure at BTM x its rate, not a billing line, and add-on fees are removed (OQ-89). Other billing lines outside BTM (post-op reviews, nerve catheters, pain consults, transport) remain and can carry their own later date; post-care may instead be an event.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ChargeBasis rvg|fixed|rateTime (types.ts:519); BillingLine hours/rate; Contract.permitsIndividualArrangement as a validator-enforced gate (validateBookingForBilling.ts:222-230); seeded rate x time Booking (seed/bookings.ts:720) and capture UI.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Delete rateTime basis, gate field, validator branch, seeded scenario and UI; add an optional date on a billing line. Do with DM-07 so the Contract shape is touched once.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Validator cite corrected :104 to :222. The retired US-03.3.7 note says rate x time was merged into US-03.3.6, but US-03.3.6 says it is removed; logged as a catalogue contradiction, delta follows US-03.3.6.

dataModelDeltas.title: Authorising a List snapshots each Procedure's Contract version and pricing inputs; the billing engine reads the snapshot
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On AUTHORISED the engine snapshots per Procedure: procedure, Contract version, resolved values and source layers, recorded BTM, rate and discount used, price and price source, payer or billable party. Later changes to RVG, procedures or Contracts never alter an issued invoice, which can be reproduced from the snapshot. The ledger records the units and dollars attributed to each Procedure (US-05.3.5). Engine resolves no route or payer.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: authoriseList (lifecycle.ts:262) only sets state. The billing run later resolves Contract and fee at run time (invoiceBuild.ts:114, :264; billingRun.ts:68) and stores amounts plus rate text in invoice line descriptions; InvoiceLine.procedureId is optional (types.ts:688). No stored Contract version or resolved layers.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New PricingSnapshot per Procedure written at authorisation and read by the run and by invoice regeneration, carrying the per-Procedure units and dollars; the immutable lock now covers the Contract version. Needs DM-07, DM-10, DM-50, DM-11. Per-Booking failure isolation (billingRun.ts:68-165) stays.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: authoriseList confirmed to set state only. Added US-05.3.5 (per-Procedure share) to refs and impact.

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract carries invoice layout, delivery method and the holder references a Booking must supply
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract sets invoice layout (holder or patient), delivery method (email, or portal upload for a direct insurer) and GST treatment. It also names references its holder needs (member number, claim reference, PO); the Booking asks for them and completion requires them. No invoice email on the Contract. The configurable required-inputs story US-04.2.7 is Retired.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Layout derived from counterparty kind at build time (invoiceBuild.ts:216; Invoice.layout types.ts:679). One free-text Procedure.billingReference with a completeness check. No delivery-method field; emailing is a stamp (billingRun.ts:398).
dataModelDeltas.impact: A few Contract fields and a Booking-side reference map keyed by the Contract's declared inputs; completion blocker updates. Depends on DM-07.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.2.7 is Retired and is cited only as the boundary; the live basis is US-04.2.2, US-03.6.1 and US-04.2.8.

dataModelDeltas.title: Procedure keeps source wording exactly as received, with later different wording added beside it
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each Procedure keeps the text exactly as the originating system sent it (feed, PDF, email), never edited; later different wording is added with source system and time; manual entry has an optional 'as given' field. Every booking screen in both apps shows a stack: as received, procedure and RVG code, then Contract name/holder/who is invoiced/pricing basis. Invoice uses the procedure's own wording (to confirm).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: One editable free-text Procedure.description (types.ts:453). IntegrationMessage keeps raw text (types.ts:852) but the Booking does not; no history of wordings, source system or time, no 'as given'.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New append-only source-text list on Procedure written by every intake path (manual, integration, PDF ingest, matching screen); three-part stack on all booking screens, review and matching. Pairs with DM-13 and DM-34.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-02.5.7 and US-03.1.9 Confirmed; the Booking holds only Procedure.description, confirmed in types.ts.

dataModelDeltas.title: Who is billed: the Contract's holder or the payer named on the Booking, replacing the per-Procedure billable-party override
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Contract decides who is billed: the holder's billable party when the holder pays AA, otherwise the payer on the Booking. Every Booking names a payer (name, email) prefilled from the patient, editable by office or anaesthetist to a parent or guardian; payer email required on that path (working rule: blocks completion); under-18 payer is a mild warning; guardian details live on the Booking, archived after the debt, not a master record. Greg/draft design want a single billable-party reference table incl. patients and guardians (tension). OQ-67, OQ-54, OQ-78 answered.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Per-Procedure billablePartyId override to a BillableParty master (types.ts:127; createBillableParty billablePartyActions.ts:21) with its own Xero contact (types.ts:768). Default payer is the patient on the Billable Party route. Counterparty is a CounterpartyRef union (types.ts:73) chosen by counterpartyForProcedure (invoiceBuild.ts:192). No Booking-level payer or payer-email rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Booking gains payer fields; counterparty becomes holder-billable-party or Booking payer; BillableParty master dropped or repurposed as the reference table; Xero contact keying stays on a hidden id. 13 non-test files read billablePartyId. Needs DM-48, DM-10; DM-28, DM-19, DM-31 build on it.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-11.2.2/11.2.3 confirm the Booking payer; the billable-party-table tension is real (US-11.2.2 technical discussion) and recorded. File count 13 non-test confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Splitting a Procedure's fee between payers is a Booking action with typed $ or % shares, not a line-level funder override
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On a Booking the user splits a Procedure's invoiced fee between several billable parties; each share is a typed $ or %; each party gets its own invoice. Not a Contract setting (US-04.2.12 Retired, boundary only); separate from an additional invoice. Basis is our pick (OQ-68); whether % must total 100 is open.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingLine.funderOverride (types.ts:528) with a conservation rule (lines must sum to the computed fee); office-only allocation (billingLineActions.ts:138, :218). Grouping invoices by counterparty per Booking is built and aligned (invoiceBuild.ts:264).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replace line-level overrides with a per-Procedure shares record (party, $ or %); validator and allocation sheet adapt; grouping unchanged. Needs DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-08.2.3 is Verify, so this delta is verify-grade. Code cites confirmed (setBillingLineAllocation, setProcedureFunderAllocation).

dataModelDeltas.title: Booking may carry an insurance indication that guides the Contract but never decides who is billed (storage open)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Booking may carry the patient's insurance indication (e.g. SXAP) guiding which Contract is chosen; the Contract still decides who is billed. An insurer-will-pay Booking with no insurer Contract is an office-review warning, not a block. Whether and where it is stored is OQ-93; no Insurer route remains.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: None. Procedure.insurerId is the payee of the Insurer billing route (types.ts:453); accRelated is informational.
dataModelDeltas.impact: One field plus a review warning rule (DM-31) once OQ-93 is answered; insurerId stops being a route. Tiny but blocked on an owner decision.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: OQ-93 Open; US-07.2.2 and US-11.4.1 notes confirm the indication and warning.

dataModelDeltas.title: NHI is required: a missing NHI is a visible problem and blocks authorising the List
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Patient keyed on NHI (or proposed own ID plus NHI as second unique index; OQ-49 open), NHI required. A Booking without one is on a problem list (patient, List, surgeon's rooms); working assumption (US-11.1.4, status Open): Booking proceeds flagged, authorising blocked. Anaesthetist sees the NHI or 'NHI missing'; Bookings searchable by NHI or name; later NHI attaches to the single record.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Patient.nhi optional (types.ts:103); upsertPatient creates a 'createdProvisional' record without an NHI (intake.ts:127). Hidden internal ID and dual-format validation aligned. No problem list; authoriseList (lifecycle.ts:262) has no NHI check; no NHI search.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Derived problem-list selector, authorise guard, merge path when the NHI arrives, NHI shown or flagged in both apps. Shape depends on OQ-49 (blocking rule is a working assumption). Interacts with DM-03 and DM-34.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Confirmed no NHI check in authoriseList. The block-on-authorise is only a working assumption (US-11.1.4 Open), which the delta already says.

dataModelDeltas.title: Slot becomes a stored entity separate from List; Day parents both
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Settled logical model (OQ-64): a day holds an AM and PM Slot for every active anaesthetist, stored across the rolling horizon (four months today, a rarely changed setting), empty ones included. A Slot is a box with a status, default times with per-Slot override, and holds at most one List; with none it has no surgeon or hospital. Slots and Lists are both children of the day. New anaesthetist gets Slots from start date. The word 'slot' never appears in the UI. Storage is left to the developers.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No Slot. One List per anaesthetist x date x session with id derived from the slot (listIdForSlot, canvas.ts:45; List types.ts:301). An empty slot is a List with statusKey 'free' and state 'DRAFT'. reassignList deletes the target's free List and mints a regenerated List for the vacated slot (lifecycle.ts:543). Horizon 14 days back, 4 months forward (clock.ts:86-88). No Day entity; times override on the List.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Largest schedule-side change. Introduce Slot (anaesthetist, date, session, status, optional times) on the deterministic slot id; List gets its own id and slotId. 9 non-test files use listIdForSlot/listForSlot and 46 read schedule.lists (generator, seed, availability, reassignment, dashboards, calendars, scale test). Logical-model change; a Draft List with no anaesthetist cannot be keyed by a slot id, so some separation is forced. Must precede DM-52 to DM-42, DM-53, DM-34.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Catalogue and prototype claims confirmed. Impact count '27 files' was unsupported; replaced with 9 and 46. Added that storage is left to developers.

dataModelDeltas.title: List lifecycle becomes DRAFT, ACTIVE, SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED, where DRAFT means no anaesthetist
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: DRAFT = no anaesthetist (Draft List); ACTIVE once it has all five of its pairing; then SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED. A List set up with its anaesthetist starts ACTIVE; an ACTIVE List returned to the office (moved, withdrawn, automated reschedule clash, which is the Future Work path of US-02.5.2) becomes DRAFT again. Anaesthetist completes and submits only while ACTIVE; no Returned state. Slot availability is separate. Until 7 Oct 'DRAFT' meant today's ACTIVE.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ListState DRAFT|SUBMITTED|AUTHORISED (types.ts:46) where DRAFT means assigned and editable and also labels every empty free Slot-List. Guards (editRefusal lifecycle.ts:48-70), submit and authorise key on 'DRAFT'; 16 non-test files reference it. No Returned state (aligned).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Semantic rename across guards, selectors, seed, chips, tests (16 files) plus a new ACTIVE to DRAFT transition. Do in the same change as DM-02 and DM-03 so the old meaning is never mixed; PERSIST_VERSION bump.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: File count 16 non-test confirmed. Reschedule-clash route marked Future Work (US-02.5.2 swimlane); return-to-office and withdrawal remain first release.

dataModelDeltas.title: Draft List: a List with no anaesthetist that can hold Bookings and is assigned by the office
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Draft List has no anaesthetist; hospital, surgeon, day, session required; takes no Slot; can hold Bookings. Arises from a room request, an anaesthetist returning a List (incl. marking its Slot unavailable), a recurring booking on an unavailable Slot, and the matching screen; an automated integration reschedule clash also produces one but is Future Work (US-02.5.2). Shown prominently in the Admin App; only an admin assigns it (making it ACTIVE), never offered to anaesthetists (OQ-86); can be removed or re-dated.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing. List.anaesthetistId is mandatory (types.ts:304) and every Booking hangs off a List id (types.ts:373). The generator silently drops a recurring booking on an unavailable availability row (canvas.ts:112-119). No Draft List screen in the admin nav.
dataModelDeltas.impact: List.anaesthetistId optional; Draft List page, day-dashboard rows, planning panel, assign/remove/re-date actions; emitted by DM-05, DM-53, DM-34. Assignment shows preference conflicts (DM-54). After DM-02 and DM-52.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Source list adjusted: the integration-reschedule route is Future Work (US-02.5.2). Rest confirmed; admin nav has no Draft List entry.

dataModelDeltas.title: Slot status is user-maintained master data kept from one availability calendar, with series
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Statuses are a user-maintained list: fixed internal ID, editable label and colour; rules read the ID; start set free (default), on holiday, unavailable. The anaesthetist keeps status up per Slot from one calendar (mark days off, create a series, edit/delete one instance); same mechanism as Slot status, independent of bookings. A List in the Slot shows in place of the status. Whether private/public/pre-op survive as list kinds is not stated.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ListStatus master keyed by a compile-time six-value LIST_STATUS_KEYS union (types.ts:51-61, theme parity-tested) mixing availability with list kind (private, public, preop); admin screen view-only (MasterData.tsx:453). A separate AnaesthetistAvailability master (types.ts:603) is reconciled into the List by setAvailability (lifecycle.ts:698): only a truly free List restatuses, else an availability ListConflict. No series or instance exceptions.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Statuses become data (id, label, colour); the availability master folds into the Slot; series (rule plus exceptions) is new; theme parity test and legend read from data. Home of private/public/pre-op kinds needs an owner decision. After DM-02.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-01.2.2 and US-01.5.3 confirm; code confirmed. Private/public/preop fate is genuinely unstated.

dataModelDeltas.title: An anaesthetist moves their own List to the office or a colleague with no confirmation; marking a Slot unavailable forces return or assign
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Anaesthetist moves a List to the office (becomes a Draft List) or pushes it into a colleague's free Slot; no acceptance or office confirmation; withdrawing also returns it to a Draft List. Marking a Slot unavailable while it holds a List forces return or assign. Colleague sees it with a notice; office notified via the shared pool and offered the cover-change email. No preference warning on this hand-over. Slot left behind is OQ-84. Conflicts remain only for hospital closures and a Booking landing on an already-unavailable Slot.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: CoverRequest offer/request marker on a Free List (types.ts:277; requestCover lifecycle.ts:843), simulated, nothing moves. Whole-List move is office-only (reassignList lifecycle.ts:543, refuses non-office actors; target must be Free; vacated slot regenerates with office-chosen status). Marking a booked Slot unavailable only flags an availability ListConflict (lifecycle.ts:698-830).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replace CoverRequest with anaesthetist-actor move actions on the Slot/List model; mark-unavailable stops producing the availability conflict; mobile cover sheet becomes a move sheet. Posts to DM-41. Needs DM-02, DM-03, DM-04.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: reassignList office-only guard confirmed at lifecycle.ts:551; US-01.4.3 and US-01.5.5 Confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: A single Booking moves to a colleague, and whoever submits a List did its procedures
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An anaesthetist can move one Booking to another anaesthetist found by search; a receiver marked unavailable first sets themselves available. The List's anaesthetist did every procedure: a Booking done by someone else moves to a List of theirs (even a one-Booking List), and its payable and any prepayment payee follow, with no recalculation. Experience and notification are open (OQ-85); US-01.4.7 and US-01.4.6 are Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: reassignBooking (lifecycle.ts:635) moves a Booking and Procedures between Lists; an anaesthetist may only move between their own Lists ('notOwnList'), the office anywhere not AUTHORISED. Payables attributed via booking-to-list-to-anaesthetist when read (selectors.ts:611). No receiver-availability rule, no receiver List creation, no notification.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Permit cross-anaesthetist Booking moves by the anaesthetist, create or find the receiver List in a Slot, repoint the payable half (DM-21, DM-22). Needs DM-02, DM-03; notifications via DM-41.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: 'notOwnList' guard confirmed at lifecycle.ts:664-669. Stories are Verify; the delta says so.

dataModelDeltas.title: Shared notification pool in the Admin App
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One pool for the whole admin team (not per user) for things that happened and need no action; separate from the warnings to-do list; newest first, paginated. First source: an anaesthetist moving their own List (which List, to whom). What else posts, expiry, actioned state are open (OQ-79).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing. requestCover is documented as simulated with no real notification (lifecycle.ts:843). No admin screen or nav entry.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New append-only slice plus admin screen and dashboard entry; written by DM-05/DM-42 and launches the update email (DM-35). Otherwise independent; can be built early.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Admin nav (SideNav.tsx) has no notifications entry; FT-13.8 Confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Recurring booking replaces the Permanent List; a pairing that lands on an unavailable Slot becomes a Draft List
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A recurring booking is the standing hospital + anaesthetist + surgeon on a day of week and AM/PM, painted onto Lists across the horizon before any Bookings exist. The anaesthetist's calendar is painted first; a recurring booking landing on an unavailable Slot creates a Draft List. Replaces 'template', 'permanent booking', 'Permanent List' (OQ-81).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: PermanentList (types.ts:585) with nullable hospitalId and surgeonId and a statusKey; the generator paints availability then the template, silently dropping the template under an unavailable row (canvas.ts:112-119); admin add/edit exists (mastersActions.ts:398-443).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Rename; decide whether null hospital/surgeon (pre-op at AA's rooms) survive; emit a Draft List instead of dropping the pairing. Depends on DM-03; seed and master screen change.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-01.3.2 is Verify; OQ-81 parts 1 and 2 settled. canvas.ts branch confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Private two-way pairing preferences and an admin-only anaesthetist priority tier
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admin staff keep private preferences between a surgeon and an anaesthetist in both directions, not-preferred and preferred (which side asked, optional reason), shown on both profiles, never to anaesthetists. When admin assign/move a List, available anaesthetists with a conflict are shown separately (soft warning). Each anaesthetist has an admin-only tier (Gold Elite, Gold, Silver, Bronze default; provisional names) ordering suggestions, shuffled within a tier. Names OQ-102. US-13.6.4 and US-01.3.6 are Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing: no preference entity, no tier on Anaesthetist (types.ts:141); assignment pickers do not separate or order candidates.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New Preference record plus Anaesthetist.tier; admin profile screens; assignment, reassign and availability-finder pickers need grouping and a seeded deterministic shuffle. Privacy boundary so anaesthetist apps never read it. Needs DM-32; feeds DM-03.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Confirmed absent in code; stories Confirmed/Verify.

dataModelDeltas.title: Surgeons' rooms, surgeon profile, hospital contact email and fuller anaesthetist profile are master data
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Rooms are master records (name, contact email/phone, member surgeons); a surgeon has a profile (room, NZ registration number, HPI CPN unique) and surgeon groups; hospitals hold a contact email. Anaesthetist profile holds contact, registration number, HPI CPN, bank details in the system, unit value, GST period, prepaid settings, priority tier and a start date that drives their Slots.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Hospital is id+name (types.ts:155); Surgeon id, name, specialty (types.ts:160); Anaesthetist has registration number, contact, unitValue, gstPeriod, hpiId (rename only), active (types.ts:141). No rooms, contact emails, surgeon identifiers, bank details or start date.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Mostly additive: SurgeonRoom entity, new fields, Master Data forms, seed, persisted-state bump. Update-email addressing (DM-35) and missing-NHI flow (DM-30) read room email. Low risk; can run early.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Types confirmed; US-13.4.1 lists hospital contact email, surgeon groups and rooms.

dataModelDeltas.title: Hospital bookings land on a matching screen as import rows with an admin decision and an unmatched queue
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Hospital bookings import into a matching screen. Per row the admin matches to an existing List/Booking, creates a Booking on an existing List, creates a List in an anaesthetist's Slot, creates a Draft List, or rejects; each row shows its text as received; later updates to a matched Booking show field differences for approval; unmatched rows stay in a queue; nothing applies until an admin decides. Automatic sync from St George's and Southern Cross only (no schedule, open-trigger or last-synced detail, per US-02.1.5 note). HL7, FHIR (FT-14.1/14.2 Future), other feeds and automatic matching (US-14.6.x Future Work), surgeon PDF ingest (US-02.2.1 Future Work) and automated changes (US-02.5.1 Future Work) are out.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Simulated HL7/FHIR messages apply straight to Bookings via processMessage (integrationActions.ts:309), with message statuses, retry and dead-letter (types.ts:852); ingestPdfRow (:434) is a canned PDF. Writes gated only by List state. No import row, match decision, field-difference view or unmatched queue.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New ImportRow and MatchDecision entities and a queue screen; feed writes move behind approval; the HL7/FHIR message log is demoted (FT-14.1/14.2 Future) or becomes the row source. Needs DM-51, DM-30, DM-02, DM-03.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-02.1.1 to 02.1.4 are Confirmed and not Future; the Future-lane items are named only as exclusions. US-02.1.5 last-synced removal confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Explicit-save change sets, an on-demand update email draft picked from the change history, and email templates
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admin saves Booking edits explicitly (unsaved warning); each save records the fields changed (before, after, who, when) in the append-only history. An on-demand 'draft update email' button lets the admin pick changes and opens a mailto prefilled with subject, boilerplate, changes and To (hospital contact for a cover change, surgeon's room for a Booking change), about 2,000 characters, nothing sent or recorded. User-configurable templates per kind of change. US-02.3.3 is Verify; automatic sending (US-02.3.5) is Future.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Append-only audit per mutation (types.ts:655, mutate.ts), not grouped into save sets; edits apply immediately (editBooking lifecycle.ts:402); no email draft, templates or contact emails.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Change-set grouping on audit entries (or a draft buffer), an email-draft launcher and a template master; admin edit form becomes explicit-save. Needs DM-32; launched from DM-41 notices.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Stories Confirmed/Verify/Proposed; absence confirmed in code.

dataModelDeltas.title: Copy a Booking and photo capture are removed from the model
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Copy a Booking is Retired (US-02.4.3, US-02.4.2) and photo capture of the booking card is in the Future Work lane (US-02.4.4, status Proposed); the anaesthetist still adds a missing Booking by hand with an optional 'as given' field. Sources: hospital download, surgeon PDF, admin entry, anaesthetist ad hoc. (domain-model.md still lists copy and photo among Booking sources: a catalogue contradiction.)
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: copyBooking (bookingActions.ts:196, built in Phase 15), Booking.copiedFromBookingId, BookingSource values 'copy' and 'anaesthetistPhoto' (types.ts:371-383); optional display-only Booking.source.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Delete copy action, field, UI and tests (8 non-test files); trim BookingSource; photo capture is deferred rather than modelled. Independent and small; PERSIST_VERSION bump only if seeded Bookings carry the removed values.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Both items are boundary removals (Retired and Future Work) and are labelled as such. File count corrected 6 to 8; US-02.4.4 status is Proposed but its swimlane is Future Work.

dataModelDeltas.title: Prepaid settings on the anaesthetist profile (procedures or whole RVG groups) trigger prepayment, replacing the per-Procedure payment category
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each anaesthetist chooses on their profile which procedures or whole RVG groups are prepaid; admin can maintain on their behalf. A Booking needs prepayment when any Procedure (or its RVG group) is in the set and the payer is a person paying for the patient, never an organisation (OQ-73), checked across the whole Booking. A pre-payable Contract flag was not adopted.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No setting. Prepayment is derived from Procedure.patientPaymentCategory === 'selfFundedPrepayment' on the Billable Party route (selectors.ts:307-313), set per Procedure by the office (types.ts:425).
dataModelDeltas.impact: AnaesthetistPrepaidSetting (procedure ids and RVG group ids); bookingRequiresPrepayment rewritten on payer type; patientPaymentCategory goes (15 non-test files). Needs DM-13, DM-11; precedes DM-20.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: selectors.ts:307-313 confirmed; stories Confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Prepayment: fixed price from the anaesthetist's own Contract, invoice drafted at setup and held for admin approval, nothing calculated afterwards
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Prepaid amount is the full fixed price on the anaesthetist's own first-party Contract line (never deposit, part or estimate), shown to the anaesthetist. Invoice generated automatically at booking setup, held until an admin approves, then sent with a standard letter template; not re-invoiced on submit. After the procedure the prepaid amount is the price, BTM reference only: no automatic invoice or credit, no threshold; extra or credit raised by hand. An issued prepayment is still deducted from the final invoice (US-08.2.2). Re-checked when Procedures, Contract or payer change (not on a move). Unpaid is a warning, never a gate. Open: OQ-92, OQ-96, OQ-97, OQ-80.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Prepayment is patientPaymentCategory + prepaymentDetail {full|split, depositAmount} (types.ts:425-438). Office raises the pre-procedure invoice by hand (prepaymentActions.ts:51); full prepayment invoices an estimated full fee from feeFor, not a Contract price; split deposit line with balance billed at the run and a visible netting line (invoiceBuild.ts:435-475). Unpaid warning built and ungated (Phase 15a), aligned.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Remove PrepaymentDetail and the split path; amount read from a first-party Contract line (DM-09, DM-19); add an Invoice held-for-approval state and letter-template master; the balance run no longer bills a difference, but the deduction line that nets the issued prepayment stays (US-08.2.2, aligned). Before DM-21. Prepayment link on Procedure (draft design) vs Booking (catalogue) to settle.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Added that the existing netting line is aligned with US-08.2.2 and that a full prepayment is today an estimated fee via feeFor. Cites widened to invoiceBuild.ts:435-475.

dataModelDeltas.title: Trust account: prepayment held pending, refunded in full on cancellation, kept when the Booking moves
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Prepayment is held in AA's trust account as pending; the anaesthetist's payable is not released until the procedure is done. A cancelled Booking's prepayment is refunded in full from trust, recorded as a credit linked to the prepayment invoice, by the office. A replacement Booking starts its own prepayment at the new anaesthetist's price. A moved prepaid Booking keeps the amount (honour system); only the payable half of its pair updates to the new anaesthetist (OQ-70, OQ-80). FT-06.5 and US-06.5.x are Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Soft cancel retains the Booking, no fee (cancelBooking lifecycle.ts:348), no refund. Prepayment payable released pro-rata as money is received (proRataAuthorised, paymentActions.ts:41), not held until the procedure. No trust concept or payee repoint.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Held/released state on the prepayment payable, a release trigger at procedure completion, a refund credit (DM-24) and a payable-repoint action called by DM-42. Needs DM-20, DM-22. Stays Verify; pair timing OQ-80.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-02.5.3 is Future Work only for the automated-cancel path; manual cancellation is first release, so the soft-cancel comparison holds.

dataModelDeltas.title: Events on a Procedure (pre-op, post-op, additional invoice, credit) replace the post-op addendum Booking
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An event is anything recorded against a Procedure after set-up, its own element attached to it, listed on the Procedure in both apps. Pre/post-op events have their own date and time, record a time or fixed fee, take no other modifiers, have an invoice tick and a 'same as the Procedure's billable party' tick. A billable event is a line on the Procedure's invoice if not yet approved, else a separate invoice in the next run, through one review step; the Contract can replace a time with a fixed fee. ACC pre-op codes open (OQ-12, US-05.5.2 Open). FT-03.7 is Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A post-op addendum is a new linked Booking (bookingType 'postOpAddendum', addendumOfBookingId; types.ts:373) with its own capture/submit/authorise/bill cycle (bookingActions.ts:290). Late fee lines are BillingLines added before invoicing (billingLineActions.ts:46). No event record, invoice tick, billable-party tick or same-run vs next-run rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New Event entity (procedure, kind, date/time, time or fixed fee, invoiced flag, billable party or same-as, invoice link); replaces the addendum Booking (6 non-test files) and post-invoice billing-line path; billing run picks events up; one review step; both apps list them. After DM-10, DM-08; DM-18 and DM-24 are event kinds.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Addendum Booking confirmed in 6 non-test files; stories Verify/Confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Additional invoice: a free-form invoice recorded as an event, to any billable party, with its own ledger pair
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin (any Procedure) or the anaesthetist (their own) adds a free-form invoice (description, quantity, amount; no Contract or unit rules) to any billable party. Traceable both ways to the original Procedure and invoice, recorded as an event, through the standard review step, with its own invoice number, ledger pair, Xero pair and payable. Uses: late post-op charges, extras after prepaid/fixed work, splitting a combined Procedure (after invoicing: credit note then additional invoices totalling the credit; split before sending OQ-77 part 3).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Invoice.kind standard|prePayment (types.ts:680) with bookingId and no link to an original invoice or Procedure; priced lines only (InvoiceLine.procedureId optional, types.ts:688). No free-form entry or second-invoice lineage.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Invoice.kind widens (additional, credit note) with originalInvoiceId and procedureId; free-form line entry UI in both apps; same pair creation and Xero handoff. Needs DM-17, DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Stories Verify/Proposed; Invoice shape confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: A wrong invoice is credited in full then rebilled; the payable is reversed by a negative invoice
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An invoice is never edited, retracted or partly adjusted: it is credited in full (to any party) and a corrected invoice raised, each traceable to the original; the ledger payable and Xero pair reverse and re-create together. The payable reversal is a negative invoice to the anaesthetist, netted in their next payment run and shown on the remittance advice. A credit note is not a refund. Rebill may start from a copy of the original lines. With no later payment to net, handled outside the system. Credit and new invoices are events.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing: no credit note, negative payable or rebill; invoices immutable once raised; BillingCase statuses pending, invoiced, handedOff, partPaid, paid, disbursed, failed (types.ts:697-707) with no credit state. 'Negative invoice' appears only in comments (invoiceBuild.ts:409, validateBookingForBilling.ts:233).
dataModelDeltas.impact: CreditNote entity linked to its invoice, a negative payable record, Xero credit mirroring, rebill-from-copy action, new BillingCase states. Needs DM-18, DM-22; precedes DM-25 and the refund in DM-21.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Confirmed absent in code; draft's 'pending to disbursed or failed' was shorthand, the status list is fuller but has no credit state.

dataModelDeltas.title: The internal ledger holds both halves of each pair as its own records, with the payable independent of Xero
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every invoice creates a linked receivable (from the billable party) and payable (to the anaesthetist) in the engine's own ledger, the system of record; Xero only mirrors an ACCREC and a draft ACCPAY created together. Ledger tracks money in and out per patient and anaesthetist and survives Xero archiving. Invoices are in the anaesthetist's name with AA as agent and a unique number; payable carries the receivable's number plus '-P'; each payable is a buyer-created tax invoice, one per procedure (OQ-29).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Ledger is the billing slice (Invoice, InvoiceLine, BillingCase with receivedAmount/authorisedAmount/disbursedAmount and Xero ids; types.ts:672-760), called a 'mirror' by the code and read by the apps instead of Xero. The payable document and amounts exist only as XeroAccPay in the Xero simulation (types.ts:790): no ledger record of its own; no '-P' numbering or BCTI wording.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Promote the Payable into the ledger (id, number, amount, authorised, disbursed, status, anaesthetist) with Xero downstream; split BillingCase into receivable and payable sides; rewire payments, payables run, selectors, Xero view. Foundation for DM-21, DM-18, DM-24, DM-23, DM-25, DM-26.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Confirmed: XeroAccPay carries the payable amounts; no ledger-side payable entity. Stories Confirmed/Proposed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Derived ledger positions for the whole ledger, per anaesthetist and per patient; flat outstanding list without ageing; patient balance alerts
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admin sees the ledger at whole-ledger scope (receivables outstanding, receipts held, payables due, disbursed, imbalance) and per anaesthetist, and a patient's invoices across all anaesthetists, patient-centric even if a guardian pays. Anaesthetist's outstanding list is flat, oldest first, no ageing buckets or age chips (US-12.2.1, OQ-59). Booking/matching a patient with a balance alerts staff: mild below the threshold (90 days from invoice date, admin-changeable), strong above, mild for credit, never a block; follow-up actions and invoice re-send recorded (OQ-41, OQ-74). US-11.3.2 is Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Per-anaesthetist outstanding list per ACCPAY invoice with agingDays and bucket (selectors.ts:584-640), which the catalogue now excludes. Boolean patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode (selectors.ts:280) surfaced as a 'Prior balance' flag in the billing monitor (BillingMonitorScreen.tsx:200); no threshold or mild/strong. No admin whole-ledger, per-anaesthetist or per-patient balance screen (admin nav has none); no follow-up record.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New pure selectors and three admin views; remove ageing buckets from the web Accounts and dashboard screens; threshold in appSettings; FollowUpAction record. Needs DM-22, DM-11; the alert rule lands in DM-31.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-12.2.1 confirms flat list with no ageing; AgingBuckets and agingDays confirmed in selectors.ts; no ledger-balance admin screen exists.

dataModelDeltas.title: Weekly payment cycle with period approval of BCTIs and a remittance advice that nets negative invoices
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A payable is released when its receivable is paid, for exactly the amount received. Payments run weekly by ISO week: Friday ledger closed and snapshotted, Monday for the office to clear problems, Tuesday the schedule goes to the accountant, anomalies roll to the next cycle; a payment shows against its week. BCTIs for a period are approved before the run (who is open). Remittance advice shows invoices paid and negative invoices netted (OQ-47, Proposed). US-10.2.6 is Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: runPayables (payablesActions.ts:146) pays every authorised-minus-disbursed amount at once under a payablesRunId (types.ts:819). No cycle or week identity, approval state, held-out anomalies, remittance advice or netting.
dataModelDeltas.impact: PaymentRun entity (ISO week, status, held-out items), approval state on payables, remittance document, netting of negative payables. Needs DM-24, DM-22. Proposed in the catalogue; keep replaceable.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: The prototype release-on-receipt rule is already aligned; the delta is only the cycle, approval and remittance parts.

dataModelDeltas.title: AA fee is a separate monthly invoice from AA to each anaesthetist, not a percentage deducted from the payable
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Monthly run raises one fee invoice per anaesthetist from fee settings: fixed charges (several items) plus a charge per BCTI issued in the month (e.g. $500 + $5 x 40 = $700), tracked in the ledger apart from any procedure's pair; Greg's view: never nets against payables, counts only paid invoices (OQ-60 open). The anaesthetist sees them with payment status. FT-10.3 and US-10.3.1/10.3.3 are Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Illustrative 5% AA service fee deducted from the ACCPAY: AA_SERVICE_FEE_RATE (agencyFee.ts:7), snapshotted on XeroAccPay as serviceFeeRate, serviceFeeAmount and net amountPayable (types.ts:790-808; xeroHandoff.ts:270), labelled 'prototype assumption only'.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Remove the deduction (payable equals receivable value, changing seeded amounts and the Xero view); add FeeSettings and FeeInvoice, a monthly run action and an anaesthetist view. Needs DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: agencyFee.ts:7 confirmed at 5%.

dataModelDeltas.title: GST schedule is on a cash basis of payables actually paid, not of amounts received
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each anaesthetist's GST schedule, aligned to their GST period, shows sales AA made for them, the GST component, and a balance check against what they were paid. Cash basis: only payables actually paid in the period are listed; outstanding falls to a later period. All prices held ex GST. US-12.2.2 is Verify.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingReceipt carries a GST component of amounts received into AA (gross x 0.15/1.15; types.ts:752, paymentActions.ts:32); the web Accounts GST report reads receipts; GST_RATE is a module constant.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Re-base the report on disbursements (the payable's paid side from DM-22) and group by the anaesthetist's GST period. Small; follows DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Receipt-based GST confirmed; catalogue says cash basis of payables paid.

dataModelDeltas.title: Warning routine: more rules, an admin to-do list and a Booking flag in both apps (one rule is built)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One routine raises warnings (before/after procedure, mild/strong, several per Booking, never blocking): unpaid prepayment, billable patient with a balance, child as payer, base units out of range, insurer-will-pay with no insurer Contract. They list on the admin dashboard as a to-do list (clearable, optional for mild) and show as a small flag on the Booking in both apps, clear when the anaesthetist opens it, no confirm on submit. Settings are Future (US-13.7.4).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Built in Phase 15a: Warning, WarningRule, WarningClearance, AppSettings (warnings/types.ts), derived warnings with one rule 'prepaymentUnpaid', a stored clearance outside the Booking, rule params in appSettings. Booking flag exists in the shared BookingDetailBody; no admin to-do screen reads openWarnings (only store/warnings.ts and tests).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Model is right; work is adding rules as source entities land (DM-11 child payer, DM-12 insurer without Contract, DM-43 out-of-range units, DM-23 patient balance) plus the dashboard to-do screen. Each rule widens WarningRuleId.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Kind changed NewEntity to ChangedEntity: the entity set is already built. Admin to-do absence confirmed by grep (openWarnings used in store only).

dataModelDeltas.title: Audit covers invoices and credit notes but not disbursements, payments or receipts
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The audit trail shows who or what made every change: creates, updates, reassignments, authorisations, invoices and credit notes. Greg (a casual remark): not disbursements, payments or receipts, which are done in Xero; depth is for the developers.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Every mutation is audited via mutate(), including simulated Xero payments and disbursements (paymentActions.ts:188 'xero.paymentReceived'; payablesActions.ts:131 'xero.disbursed').
dataModelDeltas.impact: Not a model gap: the prototype audits a superset of what the catalogue lists, so nothing has to change. Optionally filter payment and disbursement entries in the viewer. Credit notes (DM-24) must be audited.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Weakest delta: the prototype audits more than the catalogue lists, which is harmless. Kept as a policy note at S with no rebuild; the doc now says so. Line cites moved to :188 and :131.

dataModelDeltas.title: Reference data: a master public-holiday calendar and spreadsheet-loaded masters (Contract schedule upload is Future Work)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admins maintain all reference data in one place: hospitals (contact email), surgeons and groups, rooms, insurers, anaesthetists, Slot statuses, recurring bookings, a master public-holiday calendar plus each hospital's own, RVG groups, modifiers, Contracts (US-13.4.1). Loaded once from controlled spreadsheets (repeatable, failing rows reported), then hand-edited with every change recorded; Solutions Plus supplies names only; clean cut. A Contract schedule upload (US-04.2.13) is in the Future Work lane and its first-release need is open (OQ-100).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Master Data screen with partial CRUD for hospitals, insurer flag, anaesthetists, hospital holidays, permanent lists and Contracts (mastersActions.ts, contractActions.ts); holidays per hospital only (types.ts:612), no master calendar; seed is TypeScript fixtures; List statuses view-only; no schedule upload.
dataModelDeltas.impact: CRUD for the new masters (DM-13 to DM-49, DM-04, DM-54, DM-32), a master holiday calendar feeding each hospital's, optionally a CSV load script. The Contract upload preview is Future Work and out of the first-release model. Mostly follows the entity deltas.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Draft called the schedule upload a Proposed requirement; US-04.2.13 sits in the Future Work swimlane, so it is dropped from the first-release delta. Master calendar confirmed in US-13.4.1.

deltaSummary:
Verified 46 of 46 deltas: none refuted, 15 corrected in place, 0 structural deltas added. The updated doc is docs/prototype-build/catch-up/analysis/domain-model-delta.md, with a new "Verification pass" section. DM IDs are unchanged because the phase docs and plan.json cite them.

CORRECTIONS
- Scope:
  - DM-38: the Contract schedule upload (US-04.2.13) is in the Future Work lane, so only the master holiday calendar and spreadsheet loading remain.
  - DM-52 and DM-03: the integration reschedule-clash route to a Draft List (US-02.5.2) is Future Work.
  - DM-39: photo capture (US-02.4.4) is Future Work by swimlane although its status is Proposed.
- Overstated catalogue claims:
  - DM-07: the catalogue says whether Contracts carry picker categories is unsettled, not that none exist.
  - DM-20: netting an issued prepayment off the final invoice stays (US-08.2.2), so the visible deduction line is aligned. Also, the prototype's full prepayment is an estimated fee from feeFor, not a Contract price.
  - DM-45: the prototype audits a superset of what the catalogue lists, so this is a policy note with no rebuild. It stays at size S and is not dropped.
  - DM-31: the model is already built (Phase 15a), so it is a ChangedEntity, not a NewEntity.
  - DM-15: base-on-primary and time-on-every-procedure already match the prototype. The real gaps are the modifier split above four, the settable primary flag and the Contract ordinal prices.
- Citations and counts:
